user_decision.label: row-attached Add/Unstage confirmation wash, check, and text

trigger.qualifying_source: first terminal authoritative success observed for a locally initiated Add or Unstage operation in the mounted Inbox page
qualifying_results: first already_applied confirmation of the still-current local operation
non_triggers: already_applied without the current local operation identity
reconciliation replay after the first authoritative observation

placement.row_surface: complete target row without height, content, grip, or action-position change
placement.status_slot: reserved non-interactive trailing row-grid slot immediately before the stable action cluster

copy.visible: ✓ followed by the exact operation-specific copy
copy.announcement: same text once through role=status, aria-live=polite, aria-atomic=true

timeline.wash_direction: theme success emphasis back to ordinary active-row values
timeline.status_exit: remove check, copy, and success state in one step with no exit animation

interruption_and_retrigger.different_new_success: clear the prior row immediately and start one fresh timeline on the new target
interruption_and_retrigger.route_exit_or_unmount: clear active signal and page-mount identity memory
interruption_and_retrigger.theme_or_mode_change: preserve target and remaining time without retrigger

focus_and_accessibility.add: keep focus in the Add input
focus_and_accessibility.unstage: keep canonical focus on the restored source row
focus_and_accessibility.check: aria-hidden; exact copy supplies the non-color cue

reduced_motion.static_treatment: apply the theme success surface and border immediately with the same check and copy
reduced_motion.exit: clear all success treatment in one step
reduced_motion.equivalence: same copy, non-color check, target, focus, announcement, and duration as ordinary motion

theme_mapping.griddo: primary-tinted semantic row surface and border wash with canonical text and focus roles
theme_mapping.tiny-desk: paper-row highlight and stationery check-stamp treatment returning to ordinary paper
theme_mapping.neumorphism: named raised success surface and shadow emphasis returning to ordinary row depth
theme_mapping.claymorphism: shape-preserving glossy success wash and raised check treatment
theme_mapping.origami: paper highlight and emphasized seam or fold edge returning to ordinary row paper
theme_mapping.terminal: variable-driven record background and border emphasis with literal check and exact copy
theme_mapping.retro-mac: 1-bit surface and border emphasis with hard check treatment and no inversion cycling
theme_mapping.graphite: restrained grayscale row wash and strengthened editorial rule returning to ordinary row
